subject: Kickoff: Targeting playbook & scenario formation for FY28 planning
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Targeting playbook & scenario formation for FY28 planning

Team —

We need to stand up a concise targeting playbook and scenario pack to feed the QBR and the FY28 budget cycle. Goal is to have a single source of truth with three scenarios (base / upside / downside) and agreed owners for topline targets, staffing delta, and cost guardrails by April 20.

Asks: 
- Each function to provide a 1-page topline with 3 scenario numbers (revenue/ARR impact if applicable, staffing delta, critical risks) by EOD Apr 13. Use the FY28_runway_scenarios.xlsx template (linked below).
- Steph: attach OKR drift checks so we can reconcile scope changes.
- Marissa: we'll need pipeline cadence and runway assumptions from Sales and Customer.
- Vivek: ops/infra capacity and cost sensitivity (GPU hour rates + quantization savings) — rough ranges ok.

Meeting: propose a 60-min working session to align on owners and timeline — Wed Apr 14, 10:00–11:00 PT. If that doesn't work, please suggest alternatives.

Primary output: a 1-page playbook + a 6-slide QBR appendix with scenario numbers and key ask list. Attachments: FY28_runway_scenarios.xlsx (template) and QBR_playbook_v1.pptx (skeleton). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCxyz-playbook-fy28

Thanks — let's keep this lean.

Jordan Blake
VP Finance & Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Targeting playbook & scenario formation for FY28 planning

Thanks Jordan — I can own infra capacity sensitivity and a short cost model. Quick notes: 
- I'll provide a delta table showing spend vs. token throughput for three stack configs (hosted+, dedicated baseline, private op).
- Need historical utilization (Mar–May) and forecasted seq len distribution — can someone drop the telemetry export into the Drive folder?
- Confirming the Apr 13 deliverable for the first-pass numbers.

I can join the working session on Apr 14.

Vivek
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Targeting playbook & scenario formation for FY28 planning

Looping in a short sales note — attaching a filled example (FY28_runway_scenarios.xlsx) with pipeline-driven base/upside numbers and timing assumptions. Highlights: 
- Base assumes 18% conversion on current committed pipeline; upside assumes +30% expansion velocity from new enterprise play.
- Biggest risk is multi-quarter procurement cycles for two large logos (I flagged those in the sheet).

Attachment: FY28_runway_scenarios.xlsx (sales_example)

Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Planning
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Targeting playbook & scenario formation for FY28 planning

Thanks — attaching the OKR drift checklist and a short guidance note for reconciling scope/priority changes into the targets. Quick asks: 
- Can each owner annotate where the biggest OKR mismatch risk is (scope, timeline, resourcing)?
- If a target requires +FTE in the upside, call out role type and earliest start quarter.

Attachment: OKR_drift_checklist.docx (guidance)

Steph
Director, Product Ops & Program Management
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Targeting playbook & scenario formation for FY28 planning

Jordan — I can help synthesize the inputs into the QBR appendix and run the first draft deck. Couple of requests: 
1) Please ask Sales to flag top 5 accounts by probability and expected close quarter (Marissa, can you add that to the sheet?).
2) Procurement/Legal timing: for any deal >$500k we need a 10–12 week window for approvals — I'll cc procurement if we surface those deals.

I'll drop a draft of slides into the Drive folder by Apr 13 EOD.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Targeting playbook & scenario formation for FY28 planning

Appreciate the quick turn. Final coordination: 
- Marissa: add top-5 accounts + expected close quarter into the sales tab today.
- Vivek: drop utilization telemetry (Mar–May) and a 2-line sensitivity table into the Drive folder.
- Steph: annotate any OKR mismatches directly in the sheet.
- Laura: will expect the draft slides by EOD and will route procurement if >$500k deals appear.

Working session is confirmed: Wed Apr 14, 10:00–11:00 PT. Dial-in and document links in the Drive folder. We'll lock the playbook after that meeting and ship to execs for review on Apr 20.

Jordan Blake
VP Finance & Strategy
Redwood Inference
